name: RELENTLESS ONSLAUGHT
text: For the turning point, when a friendly Hierotek Circle operative shoots an enemy within 8 inches of it, its ranged weapons have Balanced. With Magnify the 8 inches is measured from the real shooter.

name: UNDYING ANDROIDS
text: For the turning point, when an operative shoots a friendly Hierotek Circle operative and you cannot retain any cover save, you may retain one defence die as a normal success without rolling it.

name: METHODICAL ELIMINATION
text: For the turning point, friendly Hierotek Circle melee weapons have Accurate 1, or Accurate 2 while fighting in an activation in which the operative has not moved more than its Move stat in total, or while retaliating.

name: COMMAND UNDERLINGS
text: Pick one (both Support): every other friendly Hierotek Circle operative visible to and within 6 inches of a friendly Cryptek, or every other friendly Hierotek Circle operative except Cryptek visible to and within 3 inches of a friendly Apprentek, takes a free Dash at once, in the order you choose.

name: CORTICAL CONTROL
text: When a friendly Apprentek or Cryptek performs a Support unique action, until it ends the operative it picks for that action only has to be visible, whatever the distance. It does not apply to Timesplinter or to a Despotek's Interstitial Command.

name: REANIMATED FUNCTION
text: When control of a marker is being worked out, pick one of your Reanimation markers: until the next turning point starts it counts as a friendly Hierotek Circle operative with APL 1 for control purposes.

name: LIVING LIGHTNING
text: When a friendly Hierotek Circle Immortal performs a Shoot action and selects a tesla carbine, until the action ends the carbine loses the 2 inches from its Devastating and gains Blast 2 inches.

name: DIMENSIONAL AMBUSH
text: During a friendly Hierotek Circle Deathmark's activation while it has a Conceal order, it may perform Guard despite that order. When it uses the free action of the interrupt its order first changes to Engage.
